verdicts.en: We wrote from him; he is truthful.
Reliable (he and his brother Muhammad both).
Reliable; we know of no criticism of him.

flags.label: Two summaries on file
flags.detail: Ibn Hajar's one word is “truthful” (saduq, the fourth of the Taqrib's twelve ranks); the editors of the Tahrir raise him to “reliable”, noting that no critic faulted him. Both are shown; the band follows the Taqrib.

bio: A Kufan transmitter of the generation after Ahmad ibn Hanbal, and a direct teacher of Ibn Majah.
